articles.title: Former Alibaba exec’s Everful raises $48.5M to connect retailers with Chinese factories
articles.summary: Everful has raised $48.5 million to expand its factory-direct sourcing platform, helping retailers source products from overseas manufacturers.

articles.title: Anthropic hits NASDAQ exchanges at $110, $27 above IPO price
articles.summary: Anthropic's IPO price was set at $83, representing more than $80 billion in new capital raised.
